## n8n config needed here
- Import + Activate this workflow.
- Copy the Webhook node's Production URL into ElevenLabs: Agent settings -> "Post-call webhook" (set on each of the 4 agents, or just Agent 1).
- This only returns the structured review as JSON (shown in n8n's execution log).
- Optional: add a Google Sheets / Airtable / Postgres node after "Code - Build Structured Review" if you want the reviews saved somewhere permanent. Not required for the course submission.
